# orchard_worker (Data Source)

Retrieves information about all workers in the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "orchard" {
  token    = "your-service-account-token"
  base_url = "http://localhost:8080"
}

data "orchard_worker" "all" {}

output "workers" {
  value = data.orchard_worker.all.workers[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `workers` (List of Object) (see [below](#nestedatt--workers))
